title: Pure Fishborg
summary: Pure Fishborg WATER Fish Tuner Synchro build led by 2024's Fishborg Harpooner, backed by Ghoti Synchro bosses and generic staples. Every Main Deck Fishborg is a self-reviving WATER Fish that climbs into Level 8 and Level 10 Synchro Monsters from the GY.

summary.title: Starters
points: Fishborg Harpooner (Level 4 Tuner) reveals itself and another WATER monster in your hand to Special Summon one of them and discard the other—putting Fishborg Launcher, Fishborg Archer, or Fishborg Planter directly into the GY.
Fishborg Archer (Level 3 Tuner) discards 1 WATER monster while you control no monsters to Special Summon itself from the GY.
Fishborg Planter (Level 2 non-Tuner) sends the top card of your Deck to the GY while it is in the GY, and if the milled card is a WATER monster, it Special Summons itself.

summary.title: Opening: Fishborg Harpooner + Fishborg Planter (or Fishborg Doctor)
steps: Reveal Fishborg Harpooner (Level 4 Tuner) and Fishborg Planter (or Level 4 Fishborg Doctor) in your hand to Special Summon one and discard the other to the GY.
Revive the discarded Fishborg from the GY (via Fishborg Planter's mill, Fishborg Doctor's revival while you control only Fishborg monsters, or Normal Summoning a second Fishborg).

Synchro Summon Level 8 Askaan, the Bicorned Ghoti (using Level 4 Harpooner + Level 4 Doctor) or climb with Level 1 Fishborg Launcher and Level 3 Fishborg Archer into Level 10 Ghoti of the Deep Beyond.
Because Fishborg Harpooner was used as Synchro Material for a WATER Synchro Monster, trigger its effect to negate the effects of 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls.

summary.title: GY Self-Revival Conditions
summary.text: Each Fishborg has a distinct condition to revive itself from the GY, so sequencing matters: Fishborg Doctor (Level 4 non-Tuner) revives while all monsters you control are Fishborg monsters; Fishborg Archer (Level 3 Tuner) revives onto an empty field by discarding a WATER monster, then destroys all non-WATER monsters you control at the start of the Battle Phase; and Fishborg Launcher (Level 1 Tuner) revives while all monsters in your GY are WATER (and can only be used for a WATER Synchro Monster). Note that once a non-WATER handtrap enters your GY, Fishborg Launcher's revival is turned off until the GY is cleared.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Ghoti of the Deep Beyond (Level 10 Fish Synchro) banishes all cards on the field when Synchro Summoned on the opponent's turn, and returns during the next Standby Phase after being banished from the Monster Zone with 500 ATK per banished monster.

Askaan, the Bicorned Ghoti (Level 8 Fish Synchro) targets 1 Fish you control and 1 card your opponent controls to banish both on Synchro Summon, and banishes 1 Fish from your GY when banished itself to Special Summon itself back.
Fishborg Harpooner negates an opponent's face-up monster when used as WATER Synchro Material.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Fishborg Blaster is Forbidden in the TCG, and the broader Ghoti and Shark Main Deck engines from the archetype page are omitted in this pure Fishborg list.

main: Newest Level 4 Tuner: summons itself or another WATER; negates as WATER Synchro material.
Level 1 Tuner: revives itself while your GY is all WATER.
Level 3 Tuner: revives itself onto an empty field by discarding a WATER.
Mills the top card and revives itself if it was WATER.
Revives itself while all your monsters are Fishborgs.
extra: Level 10 Synchro: Quick Effect Synchro Summoned on opponent's turn to immediately banish all cards on the field.
Level 8 Synchro: targets and banishes 1 Fish you control and 1 card the opponent controls on summon, and revives itself from GY.

allow.Ghoti of the Deep Beyond: Ghoti of the Deep Beyond: Endboard boss featured on page analysis.
allow.Askaan, the Bicorned Ghoti: Level 8 Fish Synchro boss providing banish removal and self-revival.
